# camundacluster_role (Resource)

A Camunda cluster role

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "camundacluster_role" "operations" {
  role_id     = "operations"
  name        = "Operations"
  description = "Operates the cluster's processes and incidents"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the role.
- `role_id` (String) The unique ID of a role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of a role (the role ID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import camundacluster_role.operations "operations"
```
